recipes.name: Golden Milk
instructions: Add all ingredients to a high-speed blender and blend on high until smooth*.
Pour this mixture straight into a saucepan. If your blender isn't very powerful, or if you don't like small fibres to remain in your drink, strain the mixture first when pouring it into the saucepan.
Bring to a gentle simmer over medium-high heat, stirring throughout. Taste test and add maple syrup if you'd prefer the drink sweeter. When warmed through, remove from the heat.
To turn it into a turmeric latte, add some brewed espresso to your cups if desired. Pour the golden milk into the cups, and enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Nutrition tip: aim to use plant-based milk that is fortified with calcium . * If you don't have a blender, simply substitute 2 dates for 1 Tbsp (15 mL) maple syrup.
Storage Best to enjoy this drink immediately.
